title: Main branch default
abstract: Use the existing main branch by default; deviate only when specifically instructed for the repository or task.

source.reference: Development quality-of-life practice inventory; original conversation not reproduced

scope_hints.trigger: When choosing a Git work branch

remarks: Single independently selectable candidate rule. Group membership is display/composition metadata, not authority, activation, authorization to execute, or proof that this rule applies to any project.
